## Settings YAML

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    pointer:
      key: "q"
      color: "#5F3DC4"
      pointerSize: 18
      trail: true
      trailDuration: 350
      trailSampling: 1
      trailMaxPoints: 140
revealjs-plugins:
  - pointer
```

- Press `q` to toggle pointer mode
- Trail is longer and smoother than default

## What To Check

- Low sampling (`1`) captures dense movement points
- Higher duration (`350`) keeps trail visible longer
- Trail color follows pointer color
